page.overview:
What is Adventure Nightmarionne?

is an unlockable character added in the 1.2 update for FNaF World. He can be unlocked by beating Foxy.EXE.

Nightmarionne has a somewhat identical appearance to his counterpart in the core series. His pupils are larger and his body is a lot more rounded-off, therefore losing his former skeletal-ish structure. His legs are smoother and less pointier.

{| class="article-table" style="width: 55%;" border="0" cellspacing="1" cellpadding="1"

Nightmarionne is an incredible character to use, and either him or Adventure Nightmare BB is needed for the Geist Lair. Nightmarionne has Prize Ball 2, which can do a random attack Such as Freddles, Pizza Wheel 2, Gloom Balloon, or Waterhose 2 that can deal big damage to groups of enemies.
